proposals.evidence: Turner distinguishes *calyati (Pk callai) from simple calati: explicit comparanda include Marwari cālṇo, Gujarati cālvũ, Punjabi callṇā and Jaunsari cālṇu. These long-vowel cāl-/sāl-/tsāl- walking responses and ordinary inflections are qualified members of that western family, retaining local affricate/spirant variants. Compounds with independent auxiliaries are excluded.

proposals.evidence: These short-vowel cal- responses are compared with Turner calati (Hindi calnā, Oriya caḷibā and Old Marwari calaï). The record is a single inflected verb or an imperative/past pair of that same stem. Local transfer remains possible; aspirated cʰel- is a qualified Bagheli variant. Long-vowel cāl- and independent auxiliaries are not collapsed into this group.
